projects.name: Corsicana Facility
projects.quote: In April 2024, Riot energized 400 MW substation and began self-mining operations at the Corsicana Facility

projects.name: Corsicana Phase II
projects.quote: Corsicana Phase II Capital Expenditures $65 million ▪ Includes capex for a 600MW substation development and other long-lead items

projects.name: Block Mining acquisition (Kentucky)
projects.quote: In July 2024, Riot acquired Block Mining for $92.5 million consideration at closing

projects.name: Commerce 30MW expansion
projects.quote: Includes $14MM for 30MW expansion at Commerce and $9mm for 30MW expansion at Blue Steel, growing total Kentucky power capacity from 60MW to 120MW

projects.name: Blue Steel 30MW expansion
projects.quote: Includes $14MM for 30MW expansion at Commerce and $9mm for 30MW expansion at Blue Steel, growing total Kentucky power capacity from 60MW to 120MW

projects.name: Coleman Road
projects.quote: Includes $35MM of miner payments (43% of total order) for Coleman Road, which is expected to be energized in H1 2026
